cohort: The study included 128 patients diagnosed with placenta previa who underwent cesarean section, categorized into subgroups with and without placenta accreta spectrum.
finding: Planned cesarean section leads to better obstetric, neonatal, and surgical outcomes compared with emergency cesarean section in pregnancies complicated by placenta previa, especially in those with placenta accreta spectrum.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean section resulted in better obstetric, neonatal, and surgical outcomes, including fewer hysterectomies and shorter hospitalization, compared to emergency cesarean section for pregnancies with placenta previa.
